quests.title: Courage Is in the Heart

dialogue.t: Huh? These hilichurls dropped something strange...
It seems to be made out of flowers. Weird, but these flowers are ordinary and were picked quite some time ago, yet they still haven't wilted.
Paimon can sense quite a lot of Dendro energy on it, and it's been discarded here, too...

dialogue.sit: It might be from a Dendro hilichurl...

dialogue.t: Yeah, must be.
Hmm, this flower thing has so much Dendro energy that it didn't even wither in the hands of the hilichurls.

dialogue.sit: Maybe they carried it with them all the time.

dialogue.t: Yep, let's return this to the Aranara as soon as possible.
Let's go inside the house, {NICKNAME}. Maybe whoever lost it is super bummed out right now!
(The first few pages contain very small and scribbled writing...)
"Ohhh... I can't believe there is a Nara willing to be Arashakun's friend. What a good Nara! The good Nara didn't mind timid Arashakun, and even taught Arashakun how to write Nara words..."
"...Good Nara comforted Arashakun when Arashakun was frightened by a leaf that fell on his head. Good Nara is Arashakun's friend forever!"
(The handwriting becomes tinier and more flustered in the following pages...)
"Oh no... Nara friend was taken by Furry Mask Demon King! It has such long arms. So scary..."
"But... must save Nara... Ohh..."
(The following pages are written in big, forceful handwriting...)
"The Furry Mask Demon King has been defeated! Saved Nara friend, and Nara friend gave Arashakun 'courage'! Arashakun is not the same old timid Arashakun anymore."
"Arashakun has 'courage' now and bravely fought the furry masked monsters. No Nara nearby will ever have to worry about getting bullied by the furry masked monsters again!"
(The handwriting shrinks back down in the latest pages...)
"Oh no... How did this happen? Arashakun's 'courage' is missing... The 'courage' Nara gave to Arashakun... It must have been stolen by the Furry Mask Demon King."
"Furry Mask Demon King, arms very long, very scary. But Arashakun can do nothing after losing his 'courage'... Arashakun will go looking for it in <color=#00E1FFFF>the cave to the east</color>..."
Uh, so, is "Arashakun" the Aranara who wrote all this?
The writing in this journal is big at times and real tiny at others. The big letters are fine, but...
Gotta say, the small ones hurt Paimon's eyes a little.

dialogue.sit: Our little Paimon's having trouble reading those small letters?

dialogue.t: Hey, Paimon reads letters in normal size just fine, thank you! Paimon's just not used to reading tiny letters, that's all!
Hmm, did this Arashakun not return after writing these most recent pages...?
Let's check out that cave in the east. The journal said that his courage is missing... Can "courage" really go missing? Paimon's curious...
Are you Arashakun?
*sob*... Arashakun is indeed my name... Eek, don't come so close so quickly!
Arashakun's very grateful to you two for saving me, but I must still request that you keep a certain distance... *sob*
That will make Arashakun feel a bit more comfortable...
What? We just rescued you!
I'm sorry! Sorry for my rude request. Sorry for angering you...
But I've been trapped here and am still... I—I haven't settled down yet. *sob* Please forgive me...
It's okay, it's okay...
Okay, thank you. May Arashakun get your names?
It's Paimon.
Golden Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon... So, how come you know Arashakun's name?

dialogue.sit: We read the journal in the house.

dialogue.t: Golden-haired Nara {NICKNAME} read the journal and came looking for Arashakun? Then rescued trapped Arashakun? Nara is so kind and so powerful.
*sob* If Arashakun hadn't lost "courage," Arashakun wouldn't have been so helpless...
We read about that in the journal. What did you mean by missing "courage," Arashakun?
This is a story from long, long ago...
Many moons ago, Arashakun was just like the Arashakun now, without "courage." Back then, even the sound of a twig snapping would keep Arashakun up at night...
But even timid Arashakun had a Nara friend for a companion. That Nara friend was no mighty Nara Varuna, but was still a very good Nara!
He never teased timid Arashakun. When Arashakun felt scared, he would hold Arashakun's hand. He was a friend Arashakun would never forget.
But one day, that Nara was taken by the Furry Mask Demon King...
Wait, what's this Furry Mask Demon King you speak of?
Furry Mask Demon King is a furry demon king wearing a mask.
Uh, yeah, sure...

dialogue.sit: Do you know what it is, Paimon?

dialogue.t: There's no way Paimon would know that...
But the Furry Mask Demon King captured Arashakun's friend.
The Furry Mask Demon King was very cunning. Just thinking about it makes Arashakun shudder.
*sob*... When Nara friend was taken, Arashakun was afraid of getting beat up by the Furry Mask Demon King, but was even more terrified of never seeing Nara friend again.
So Arashakun tried very hard! Closed eyes! Gritted teeth! Used hands and hit, and hit, and hit! Then saved Nara friend.
After that, Nara friend used flowers to make a "Talisman of Courage" and told Arashakun, "Arashakun is a good Aranara with courage, not a timid Aranara!"
So from then on, Arashakun had "courage."
But wasn't "Closed eyes! Gritted teeth! Used hands and hit, and hit, and hit!" very courageous?
No. Arashakun only had "courage" after getting it from Nara friend.
But your act to save your friend was already brave.
No, no, no. Arashakun was so scared when saving Nara friend. Arms and legs, all shaky. But after getting "courage," Arashakun's arms and legs were not weak anymore.
Ah...

dialogue.sit: The talisman was just a symbol.
The courage was in you all along!

dialogue.t: *sob*... Nara {NICKNAME} is making this too complicated. Arashakun just know that there is "courage" only when I have the "Talisman of Courage."
After "courage" was stolen, Arashakun came to the cave of the Furry Mask Demon King to search, hoping to find clues for Arashakun to find "courage" again.
But Arashakun ended up getting surrounded by slimes in the cave... Fortunately, the Furry Mask Demon King didn't notice.
Speaking of which... Remember that thing we picked up from the hilichurls, {NICKNAME}? Do you think that's the talisman?
Arashakun, we might have found the courage you lost!
Really? Have you really found Arashakun's "courage," Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon?
*sob*... Would Nara {NICKNAME} mind giving my "courage" back to me...?
Yes, this is it, this is it!
This is the "Talisman of Courage"! The flower has faded a bit after being apart from Arashakun for a few days...
But it's okay! Arashakun will guard it well from now on!
"Arashakun is a good Aranara with courage, not a timid Aranara!"
Thank you so much, Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon!
Arashakun now has "courage" back. Nothing can stop me! I beat Furry Mask Demon King once before and I shall do it again!
(Whoa, Arashakun's attitude and tone are completely different now.)
The Furry Mask Demon King has done a lot of evil things. Please come with me, Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon. With your help, we'll defeat it for sure!
Arashakun can feel it. Today... will be the day it meets its end!
Okay then, {NICKNAME}, let's go and see what on earth that Furry Mask Demon King is supposed to be!
Paimon had her guesses... But as it turns out, the Furry Mask Demon King really was a hilichurl all along.
A hilichurl?
Yes, the "Furry Mask Demon King" is actually a hilichurl.
Are all Hillychuchu "Furry Mask Demon Kings"?
Uh, no...

dialogue.sit: But that's all you need to know, Arashakun.

dialogue.t: Okay, Arashakun understands.
Yes, with help from Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon, Arashakun will lead the charge and be invincible! Even the devious Furry Mask Demon King will be no match!
Arashakun shall mark today with a big entry!
Yeah, a big entry in big writing!
Arashakun with "courage" and without sure feel like two completely different Aranara.
Arashakun with no "courage" has weak arms and legs, but Arashakun with "courage" can do all sorts of amazing feats!
"Courage" is not just the best gift from Nara friend, but also the most important thing to Arashakun.
Well, make sure you keep it safe and don't let the hilichurls steal it again!
Arashakun understands. Arashakun will never let "courage" go missing again!

quests.description: You found a journal by the Aranara named Arashakun in an Aranara house. Despite losing “courage,” Arashakun still decided to venture into such a dangerous place. Go check the situation out…
